definition: A line that splits a shape into two halves that are mirror images, so folding along it makes the halves fit exactly; also called a mirror line.
A shape has rotational symmetry if it fits onto itself after a turn of less than $360^{\circ}$ about its centre; its order is the number of times it fits onto itself in one full turn.
A flat slice that divides a solid into two halves that are mirror images of each other.
